title: Ferdinand Georg Frobenius: Group Character Papers, German Source and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Frobenius record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record holds source-witnessed German LaTeX transcriptions, English translation working drafts, cumulative readers, scans, and audit ledgers for selected Frobenius group-character papers.

Current public coverage: selected Frobenius group-character items 053, 054, 056, 057, 058, 059, 060, 061, 070, and 071. The package status reports all 10/10 selected items included, 221/221 tracked source-intake pages, 241 cumulative source-scan pages, German cumulative reader of 182 generated pages, and English cumulative reader of 176 generated pages.

New in this version: adds Frobenius_all_GE_EN_cum_scans_RA05_20260613.zip, an RA05 recursive-audit refresh. Package notes report English item 070 formula-punctuation fixes, directly compilable all-author cumulative TeX/PDF replacing previous source-archive concatenations, verified ZIP extraction, 221/221 aid source page images present, zero German/English structural flags, zero post-fix formula-number skeleton mismatches, and zero fatal build/layout diagnostics. This version also fronts the German and English cumulative PDF/TeX reader surfaces.

Quality note: source-witnessed working drafts, not certified critical editions. Source scans and audit ledgers are the authority; OCR/text extraction is only a locator and comparison aid. Verify important formulas, notation, theorem statements, and references against the included source witnesses.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Adds Frobenius_all_GE_EN_cum_scans_RA05_20260613.zip and fronts German/English cumulative reader PDF/TeX surfaces. RA05 is a recursive-audit/working-draft refresh, not a certified critical edition.
